question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

7, 10, 22, 49, 97, ?
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **The difference of the difference between the terms is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83a465e33ffa220c79aa8fa0f6cff542a3c688d734d2b592c695c97a6751ba53.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **option (3).**
